d: We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.
r: We are looking for a skilled Accountant with a strong background in financial reporting, revenue recognition, and regulatory compliance, ideally within the SaaS and restaurant industries. The ideal candidate will have 4+ years of accounting experience, with a solid understanding of SaaS financial operations and hands-on experience managing accounting for restaurant businesses in Saudi Arabia. This role will also work closely with the Product team to test, validate, and enhance our ERP/Accounting product, ensuring it meets real-world accounting and operational requirements.
Manage daily accounting operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and bank reconciliations.
Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with IFRS/GAAP standards.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring timely and accurate reporting.
Ensure compliance with local tax regulations, including VAT, income tax, and other applicable financial requirements.
Work closely with the Product team to test, validate, and provide accounting expertise on ERP/Accounting product features and functionalities. Revenue & Subscription Accounting
Oversee subscription billing cycles, deferred revenue, and recurring revenue reporting.
Monitor customer contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition in line with SaaS accounting standards.
Reconcile deferred revenue schedules and ensure accurate ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) and MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) calculations.
Support the accounting treatment of different revenue streams and subscription models. Financial Analysis & Process Improvement
Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning across revenue streams.
Analyze financial data and identify discrepancies, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Identify and implement process improvements to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy.
Contribute to the automation and optimization of financial processes. Audit & Internal Controls
Support internal and external audits by preparing financial documentation and providing relevant insights.
Maintain effective internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure financial integrity.
Establish and implement best practices in accounting operations, financial reporting, and compliance.
Support intercompany reconciliations and ensure proper documentation of related-party transactions. What Are We Looking For❓
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA, CMA, or ACCA certification is a plus.
4+ years of accounting experience, preferably including 1–2 years in a SaaS or subscription-based business.
Hands-on experience managing accounting operations for restaurants or F&B businesses in Saudi Arabia.
Strong understanding of IFRS/GAAP accounting principles and financial reporting standards.
Experience with accounting and ERP systems, preferably SAP S/4HANA.
Familiarity with subscription billing systems and CRM platforms, preferably Salesforce.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with financial analysis and modeling.
Working knowledge of Saudi tax regulations, including VAT and ZATCA requirements.
Understanding of transfer pricing principles and intercompany transactions.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in written and spoken English. Who Will Excel❓
Experience working with SaaS financial KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Churn Rate, ARR, MRR, and Expansion Revenue.
Familiarity with restaurant accounting practices, F&B operations, and related financial workflows.
Knowledge of accounting automation tools and process optimization.
Experience working in a multinational or regional business environment. What We Offer You❗
We believe you will love working at Foodics!
We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-offices.
We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

d: Role Description The Director at HOMIE Furniture Marketplace is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Qesm El Mataria. This position is responsible for overseeing daily operations, including sales performance, customer experience, inventory management, and store presentation. The Director will set strategic priorities, align teams on goals, and monitor key performance indicators to ensure sustained growth and profitability. Responsibilities include managing and mentoring department leads, coordinating with suppliers and logistics partners, and implementing policies and processes that support efficient, high-quality service. The Director will also collaborate on marketing initiatives, budget planning, and long-term business development, while fostering a culture of accountability, inclusivity, and continuous improvement.
q: Demonstrated experience in senior leadership or director-level roles within retail, furniture, or marketplace environments.
Strong skills in operations management, including inventory control, staff scheduling, and process optimization.
Proven ability to lead and develop diverse teams, with effective performance management and coaching practices.
Solid background in sales management, customer service excellence, and driving store or business profitability.
Experience collaborating with suppliers, logistics, and other external partners to ensure timely and reliable product availability.
Comfort with data-driven decision-making, including monitoring KPIs, budgeting, and financial planning.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
Ability to work on-site in Qesm El Mataria and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving marketplace environment.
Commitment to building an inclusive, respectful workplace and delivering a positive experience for customers and team members.

d: The Senior IT Project Manager will be responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of complex technology projects within the financial services sector, preferably banking. The role requires strong project governance, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, regulatory awareness, and proven experience delivering IT initiatives across international or multi-country environments.
q: Minimum 7 years of actual hands-on project management experience, with responsibility for managing scope, schedule, cost, risks, resources, stakeholders, vendors, and delivery outcomes.
Proven experience delivering IT projects within the financial services sector, preferably banking.
Experience managing medium to large-scale IT projects in banking or financial services environments.
Demonstrated experience managing projects in international, regional, or multi country environments.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid delivery approaches.
Experience managing internal teams, external vendors, consultants, and third party service providers.
Experience working with senior management, business sponsors, technology teams, and external vendors in a structured governance environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
Additional certifications such as PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, ITIL, COBIT, or PMI ACP are preferred.
